## Why
Cart art for the 7800 shelf.

## Scope
- [ ] Retro bitmap 7800 card (the taller ProSystem-era shell).
- [ ] `tools/fetch-labels.py`: system `A7800`, dat `Atari - 7800` (headerless `.bin` CRCs: Asteroids (USA) `DFB93F40` equals his dump), ScreenScraper id **41** (row `atari7800,41,34,27`); hash the body without a 128-byte header when one is present.

## Tests
| ID | File | Asserts |
|---|---|---|
| (new) | `tools/tests` | a headered and a headerless copy of the same body resolve to one dat entry |

## Edge cases
| Case | Expected handling |
|---|---|
| Header present but body not in the dat | Name match, else the plain card |

## Acceptance
- [ ] Labels for his 66 games fetched into `Labels/A7800`.
